title: Acceptance-criteria tests
prompt:
Write/aggregate tests covering each PRD §11 acceptance criterion. Ensure coverage on the engine and both gatekeepers keeps total >=85%.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: Consolidated PRD §11 acceptance suite: each of the 15 criteria mapped to a named test (test_acceptance_criteria.py + test_acceptance_criteria_meta.py + _acceptance_criteria_helpers.py), reusing existing offline helpers. Engine + both gatekeepers exercised; total coverage 99.7% (>=85%).
